title: Evan K NDE 990
content: First thing I experienced was a large flash of light (figured it was impact of a guard-rail), then darkness (unconsciousness). About half an hour later, I was walking around dazed then entered a seizure type fit. I saw myself on the Emergency Room table but couldn't feel or hear anything. Then everything turned into a great void of light with a sense that I cannot explain. Have never yet felt that feeling. When I finally woke up over four hours had past and I was being told that during that time I didn't know where I was, who I was or what the date was. Shortly after I discovered bumps or scars on the palms of my hands, which look like round half pea size dots, one is outwards and the other inwards. If I scrape them off they come back the next day.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes AccidentSuicide attempt Life threatening event, but not clinical death Head on collision with a guard-rail at roughly forty-five mph, ripped approximately one hundred and fifty feet of guard-rail, sound heard about quarter of a mile away, car flipped end to end forcing engine into front seating area.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I don't know exactly how to answer this question, during out of body experience when I was younger I felt much different than near death experience.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was told it was not my time.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was told it was not my time. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes. I do not fear death.
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes. I do not fear death. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes The sense of feeling, something that nothing comes close to in life.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I can 'read' people, example: know whether their intentions are good. 'Good' meaning not using for benefit of themselves.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Knowing what happens when you die.
